music.prompt: Warm organic instrumental groove at 104 BPM that starts immediately at full groove on the first beat, with no intro and no fade-in: bright plucked marimba melody, soft hand claps on the backbeat, a round warm upright-style bass, a light kick and shaker. Playful, optimistic, human and handmade, like a thoughtful product film. Steady energy all the way through with no build-ups and no breakdowns, ending on a warm sustained chord. No vocals, no singing, no electronic synth leads.
